No playbook task failed in job 6620417, and no host was involved. The playbook never ran.

get_job shows the job failed two seconds after it started (14:21:37 to 14:21:39 UTC on 2026-10-09, duration_seconds 2). Its job_explanation is:

  Previous Task Failed: {"job_type": "project_update", "job_name": "agnosticd-v2 content (west)", "job_id": "6620409"}

That is AWX saying a dependency failed before the job could start. A job first triggers a project update that syncs the playbook content from git, and that sync, project update 6620409 for the "agnosticd-v2 content (west)" project, failed. The provision job was then marked failed without running a single task. There is nothing to fix in the lab's roles.

Next step: open project update 6620409 on the west controller (Projects -> agnosticd-v2 content (west) -> Jobs, or /api/v2/project_updates/6620409/). It will say why the git sync failed, for example credentials, a ref that does not exist, or the git host being unreachable. Fix that, let the project sync succeed, then relaunch the provision. query_aap2 only reads job-template jobs, so it cannot show the project update itself.
